profile.text:
Before the Chernobog incident, Istina was a middle school student. In school, she wrote many articles about Originium Arts. Her areas of expertise include: Arts, detective literature, and sociology.
In a number of tests, she has demonstrated an excellent aptitude for control-type Originium Arts. She has been approved for service in battle. She also provides intel and data processing services for Rhodes Island.
